projects.brief: Build a local Python toolkit for coordinating release operations across related workflows. It should ingest structured work items, validate lifecycle transitions, resolve dependencies, produce operator summaries, and expose a stable command-line interface. Use the standard library only.

scenarios.brief: A customer evolves the toolkit through a long sequence of operational changes. Ordinary implementation attempts, observed command results, corrections, and later handoffs should disclose distinct business rules and environment observations. Later work should reuse earlier decisions without internal planning labels.
scenarios.runtime_conditions: Run in a fixed Python 3.12 standard-library environment; only public observations and corrections become historical evidence.
